answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Every claim climbs the vault of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the walnut re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the orchard of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
